title: Anonymous COPPA-safe analytics: schema, queue, sessions, kill switch, signal queries (Unit 12)
accept: Exactly the §5 event set exists, no more: session_start, story_started, word_read (with correct|near_miss|helped result field), help_given (tier), story_completed, story_abandoned, vocab_card_opened, collectible_earned, twister_started, twister_completed.

Payloads carry only: event name, timestamp, random per-install UUID, profile ordinal (1-4), level ordinal, story id, and event-specific fields (help tier, word HASH — never raw word text); schema tests validate every emitted event and any PII-shaped field (name string, raw word text, device identifier, audio, transcript, location) fails schema — pii_guard_test is the CI tripwire.
Never collected: names, age beyond age band, audio, transcripts, IDFA/AAID, location; no third-party tracker SDK is imported (test asserts no such package imports under lib/features/analytics/).

Session semantics pinned: session starts at profile selection; ends when app backgrounded > 120 s (tunable constant), app closed, or profile switch — session_tracker tested with fake clock and scripted lifecycle/profile events for all three endings.

story_abandoned fires when the reading screen is exited after story_started but before story_completed — including via session end — and carries whether a help event occurred in the preceding 30 s (the §4.4 frustration marker); tested for direct-exit, session-timeout-exit, and help-within-30s true/false cases.

Offline queue: events queue when transport unavailable, flush in batches over HTTPS when available (transport behind an interface, faked in tests); airplane-mode queue/flush verified; events unsent after 30 days are DROPPED, verified with clock manipulation.
A single build flag disables all analytics: kill-switch build emits zero transport calls (recording-fake asserts no call), and the client becomes a no-op.

The four §4 signal queries are implemented in signal_queries.dart, documented in docs/analytics/signals.md, and run against fixture event data returning correct values (tests are the executable definition): D7 profile return rate; median completed stories per session; help-rate trajectory on repeated word encounters; rate of sessions ending in mid-story abandonment after a stuck-word event. No pass/fail thresholds encoded anywhere (ratified).
pinned_design: Unit 12 pinned: events exactly as §5; payload fields exactly as listed (word text is hashed because the word list is content, but hashing keeps payloads inert). Transport: batched HTTPS to a self-controlled endpoint or privacy-first service configured anonymous (A-5: self-hosted endpoint is the default posture); queued offline; dropped after 30 days unsent. Session boundary and story_abandoned semantics pinned verbatim (see accept). Single build flag kill switch for review builds. The four §4 signals each have a defined query written down with the schema — part of this unit's deliverable. Signals are observational; no targets (§4 ratified: no pass/fail targets in v1).
notes: No network in the container: transport is an interface with a recording fake; the real HTTPS sender is a thin dart:io implementation exercised against a localhost fixture if feasible, else covered by the fake. Queue persistence: use its own small file-based store via path_provider-injected directory (NOT the Drift user DB — keeps file ownership disjoint; injection makes tests temp-dir based). OPEN-DECISIONS: analytics endpoint URL / self-host deployment (A-5) and the exact word-hash algorithm (propose SHA-256 of lowercased word — crypto is already pinned in pubspec) need owner sign-off. Event EMISSION from screens belongs to the screen tickets via AnalyticsClient; session_tracker wiring to app lifecycle + navigation happens in app-shell.
